questions.question: What is the value of $1234 + 2341 + 3412 + 4123$?
_topics: Algebra > Prealgebra / Basic Algebra > Integers

questions.question: Forty slips of paper numbered $1$ to $40$ are placed in a hat. Alice and Bob each draw one number from the hat without replacement, keeping their numbers hidden from each other. Alice says, “I can’t tell who has the larger number.” Then Bob says, “I know who has the larger number.” Alice says, “You do? Is your number prime?” Bob replies, “Yes.” Alice says, “In that case, if I multiply your number by $100$ and add my number, the result is a perfect square.” What is the sum of the two numbers drawn from the hat?
_topics: Discrete Mathematics > Logic
Number Theory > Divisibility / Factorization > Prime numbers
Algebra > Prealgebra / Basic Algebra > Integers

questions.question: A regular hexagon of side length $1$ is inscribed in a circle. Each minor arc of the circle determined by a side of the hexagon is reflected over that side. What is the area of the region bounded by these $6$ reflected arcs?
_topics: Geometry > Plane Geometry > Circles
Geometry > Plane Geometry > Triangles

questions.question:
Which of the following conditions is sufficient to guarantee that integers $x$, $y$, and $z$ satisfy the equation
$$
x(x - y) + y(y - z) + z(z - x) = 1?
$$
_topics: Number Theory > Diophantine Equations > Techniques: modulo, size analysis, order analysis, inequalities
Algebra > Prealgebra / Basic Algebra > Simple Equations

questions.question: Distinct lines $\ell$ and $m$ lie in the $xy$-plane. They intersect at the origin. Point $P(-1, 4)$ is reflected about line $\ell$ to point $P'$, and then $P'$ is reflected about line $m$ to point $P''$. The equation of line $\ell$ is $5x - y = 0$, and the coordinates of $P''$ are (4, 1). What is the equation of line $m$?
_topics: Geometry > Plane Geometry > Transformations > Rotation
Geometry > Plane Geometry > Analytic / Coordinate Methods > Cartesian coordinates

questions.question: Let $N$ be the positive integer $7777\ldots777$, a $313$-digit number where each digit is a $7$. Let $f(r)$ be the leading digit of the $r$th root of $N$. What is $f(2) + f(3) + f(4) + f(5) + f(6)$?
_topics: Algebra > Prealgebra / Basic Algebra > Decimals
Algebra > Prealgebra / Basic Algebra > Integers

questions.question: In a particular game, each of 4 players rolls a standard 6-sided die. The winner is the player who rolls the highest number. If there is a tie for the highest roll, those involved in the tie will roll again and this process will continue until one player wins. Hugo is one of the players in this game. What is the probability that Hugo's first roll was a 5, given that he won the game?
_topics: Discrete Mathematics > Combinatorics > Algebraic properties of binomial coefficients

questions.question: Regular polygons with $5$, $6$, $7$, and $8$ sides are inscribed in the same circle. No two of the polygons share a vertex, and no three of their sides intersect at a common point. At how many points inside the circle do two of their sides intersect?
_topics: Geometry > Plane Geometry > Miscellaneous > Constructions and loci
Geometry > Plane Geometry > Miscellaneous > Angle chasing

questions.question: For each integer $n \ge 2$, let $S_n$ be the sum of all products $jk$, where $j$ and $k$ are integers and $1 \le j < k \le n$. What is the sum of the 10 least values of $n$ such that $S_n$ is divisible by 3?
_topics: Algebra > Algebraic Expressions > Sequences and Series > Sums and products
Number Theory > Modular Arithmetic > Polynomials mod p

questions.question: A cube is constructed from 4 white unit cubes and 4 blue unit cubes. How many different ways are there to construct the $2 \times 2 \times 2$ cube using these smaller cubes? (Two constructions are considered the same if one can be rotated to match the other.)
_topics: Discrete Mathematics > Combinatorics > Enumeration with symmetry
Discrete Mathematics > Combinatorics > Coloring schemes, extremal arguments

The sum of all possible values for the area of $R$ can be written in the form $\frac{m}{n}$, where $m$ and $n$ are relatively prime positive integers. What is $m + n$?
